# Copilot Engineering Flow Context

## 1. Guidelines & Best Practices
- Refer to .kilocode/rules/maui-guidelines.md for MAUI-specific coding standards, UI/UX conventions, and architectural patterns.
- Adhere to the principles and instructions in .kilocode/rules/memory-bank-instructions.md for memory bank features and related logic.

## 2. Memory Bank Domain Knowledge
- Use .kilocode/rules/memory-bank/ as the authoritative source for:
  - System architecture (.kilocode/rules/memory-bank/architecture.md)
  - Project brief and high-level goals (.kilocode/rules/memory-bank/brief.md)
  - Context and background (.kilocode/rules/memory-bank/context.md)
  - Glossary of terms (.kilocode/rules/memory-bank/glossary.md)
  - Technical details and constraints (.kilocode/rules/memory-bank/tech.md)
  - User stories and requirements (.kilocode/rules/memory-bank/user-stories.md)

## 3. Engineering Flow
- When implementing or modifying features:
  1. Check for relevant guidelines in .kilocode/rules/maui-guidelines.md.
  2. For memory bank-related work, consult all files in .kilocode/rules/memory-bank/ for requirements, terminology, and architecture.
  3. Ensure all new code aligns with the documented user stories and technical constraints.
  4. Use the glossary to maintain consistent terminology across the codebase and documentation.
  5. Document any architectural or technical decisions in accordance with the structure in .kilocode/rules/memory-bank/architecture.md and tech.md.

## 4. Collaboration & Documentation
- All contributors should review the .kilocode/rules/ files before starting new work.
- Update the relevant .kilocode documentation if new patterns, terms, or requirements are introduced.
